name: ori-tour
description: Open Range Interactive tour player: a portable tour engine (src/core) with web adapters for phone and glasses (src/web), and world-locked figures (src/core/anchoring.ts).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/vendor_three.mjs && python3 tools/build_offline.py
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist vendor offline.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
